preamble: Retraction of the voiceless velar stop [k] to the uvular [q] next to back vowels. In Selkup, Proto-Samoyedic *k before back vowels regularly became q (*kålä 'fish' > Taz Selkup qē̮li̮), while it palatalized before front vowels; Tundra Nenets instead has χ and Nganasan keeps k. In Eastern (Surgut) Khanty, Proto-Khanty *k in back-vowel words is likewise uvular q (ӄуԓ [quːɬ] 'fish'), where Northern Khanty has χ.

cf. Tundra Nenets χoba, Nganasan kuhu
